openVisualDefects.description: The rosemary sprig (painted part2) has a visible gap between its lower stem and the supporting bare branch. The gap exists in the original source master and remains in the final GIF; it was not introduced by the animation or corrected zoom pivot.
openVisualDefects.requiredAction: Repair the source-art attachment or composition, regenerate the affected GIF and source binding, validate the replacement, and review its new identity before publication.
